place.name: Masilamaniswara Temple, Thiruvaduthurai
place.description: Masilamaniswara Temple, also known as Thiruvaduturai Udaiyar or Paramasvamin, is a Hindu temple dedicated to Hindu god Shiva, located in the village of Thiruvaduthurai in Mayiladuthurai district, Tamil Nadu. It is 17 km (11 mi) from district headquarters, Mayiladuthurai, and 22 km (14 mi) from Kumbakonam.
